expected_response.basis: No permitted bounded declarative edit has a defensible expected advantage under the affinity-first objective given the supplied evidence.
expected_response.expected_direction: no change to the executing pointcloud scalar; incumbent pointcloud_delta_A 1.0 A, teacher_neighbors 4, no region or temporal conditioning

failure_modes: Pair-kernel shell-density contrasts (endpoint_effects:9/10/11) cannot be expressed by any permitted edit because the executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel term; attempting to encode them via region_index or pointcloud_delta_A would be an unregistered substitution.

A region-indexed teacher attention edit risks unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates because landmark soft-min and occupancy signs are mixed and opposite at the same landmarks (endpoint_effects:14 vs :15), and joint diagnostics show internal rather than global-pose content (joint_diagnostics:14/15).

A temporal_teacher_blend edit risks fitting unvalidated curves: relative_node_rmse 0.48-0.67, strong_sign_conflict_nodes up to 15, legendre_runtime_allowed false, and only 24 of the audited curves passing the selection rule (curve_support).

Changing teacher_neighbors would treat a neighbor count as a distance bandwidth and would not be supported by the information audit, whose excess-distance metric is nonnegative by construction and not a causal affinity effect.
Any temperature proposal would be an interface violation; mixture_temperature 0.5 and teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2 4.0 are immutable fixed parameters.
Treating survival or turnover credit as final affinity benefit would conflate recorded joint-head credit and accounting residuals with decoded terminal affinity, which is unavailable.

parameter_origins.region_index: not set; no region-indexed edit proposed
parameter_origins.temporal_region_index: not set; no temporal edit proposed
parameter_origins.temporal_teacher_blend: not set; no temporal blend proposed

rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's strongest reproducible endpoint contrasts are on short-range pair-kernel shell densities (endpoint_effects:9/10/11, q 1.5e-4 to 9.8e-5, positive_batch_fraction 1.0) with reversal at 7.0 A (endpoint_effects:13), but the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit), so no registered bounded edit can express that hypothesis; the permitted edits are pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index and temporal_teacher_blend only. The region-indexed alternative is not defensible: landmark soft-min signs are mixed and occupancy shells at the same landmarks carry opposite signs (endpoint_effects:14 vs :15; :29 and :59 unfavorable), so a single 'move closer to landmark r' rule is unsupported. The temporal alternative is not defensible either: the observed-node linear contrasts show many sign changes and rate reversals (continuous:0, :1, :7) and the curve_support audit reports relative_node_rmse 0.48-0.67, strong_sign_conflict_nodes up to 15, legendre_runtime_allowed false everywhere, and only 24 of the audited curves passing the selection rule, so no validated absolute contrast change at actual score nodes is established. Teacher-neighborhood width is not supported by the supplied evidence: the information audit gives compressed_choice_excess_fixed_RMS_A 0.081 A (CI 0.070-0.092) with the explicit limitation that nonnegative excess distance is by construction and not a causal affinity effect, and top4_teacher_overlap 0.470; neighbor count is a count, not a distance bandwidth, and the fixed temperatures (mixture_temperature 0.5, teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2 4.0) are immutable. Changing pointcloud_delta_A would alter the executing curvature without any supplied evidence tying a specific delta to affinity benefit, and the incumbent already uses 1.0 A. Survival credit is largely null (survival_effects:0 q 0.120; :70; :100) and decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable, so last-record joint-head credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit. Increment contrasts disagree in sign and magnitude with endpoint contrasts (increment_effects:14 z -4.91; :10 z 3.96; :13 z -3.14) and turnover edge-versus-residual gaps (turnover:1/2, :47, :134, :227) are accounting diagnostics mixing reclassification and extant-parent weighting, not causal selection effects. Joint diagnostics indicate the informative content is internal (joint_diagnostics:14 internal fraction 0.787; :15 atom participation 0.384) versus translation/rotation (0.132/0.081), and the most reproducible branch-adjusted effects are joint-motion residual diagnostics (branch_adjusted:74/76/151/153) that the executing scalar does not contain. Under the affinity-first priority, no registered bounded declarative edit has a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent, so retaining the incumbent is the correct decision; this is not a claim that the incumbent is optimal, only that the supplied evidence does not support a specific permitted edit.
